description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class 'AppNavHomeActivity' that displays a list of sample activities for app navigation. It queries available activities, displays their labels, and starts selected activities upon user interaction.

classes.name: AppNavHomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that displays a list of sample activities and handles user selection.

classes.name: SampleInfo
classes.description: Data class holding the name and intent for each sample activity.

classes.name: SampleAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter for displaying SampleInfo items in a list.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the list adapter with sample activities.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks by starting the selected activity.

methods.name: querySampleActivities
methods.description: Queries the package manager for activities matching sample code category and returns a list of SampleInfo objects.

methods.name: SampleInfo (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs a SampleInfo object with a name and intent.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the adapter.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the item at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the item ID for the specified position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for a list item and sets its text to the sample name.
